name: Creeping Charlie
description: Five-piece roots-rock band fronted by singer Jeff Van Newkirk and singer/bassist Elizabeth Manner, known for high-energy live sets mixing rock and Americana.
activity: Played the Roy's Garage porch (103 N Union St) at Lambertville Porchfest, Oct 3, 2026 (official porch map).

name: Pyrenesia
description: Acoustic quartet (violin, accordion, guitar, bass) that blends vintage swing with gypsy jazz, klezmer and tango. Their 2019 debut Off-Beat Symphony got strong notices in NJ press.
activity: Released the live album 'Live From The Birdhouse' (recorded in Lambertville) Apr 10, 2026; New Jersey Stage Song of the Week Apr 2026; shows at Lambertville Shad Fest and Godfrey Daniels in spring 2026.

name: Necrophiliac Yacht Club
description: Trio (Spencer Johnson, Kevin Harvey, Jesse Somogyi) that bills its heavy, sludgy hardcore as 'funeral groove'.
activity: Released the single 'Mourning Sun' Apr 23, 2026, ahead of the upcoming EP 'Thank You For Your Loss'. The album 'Spectral Migraines' came out in 2025.

name: West Jersey Airport
description: Four-piece band playing downtuned noise and psych rock. They have played Flemington DIY bills alongside other local underground acts.
activity: Album 'Downtuned Delights' released May 23, 2025 (recorded 2024 in Raritan, NJ); the band's page lists a booking contact.

name: Clice
description: New four-piece (two guitars, bass, drums) playing what they call 'punk fueled shoegaze'.
activity: Released 'clice demos vol. 1' in Aug 2026, plus a single on Aug 10, 2026.

name: Proboscis
description: Duo fusing shoegaze and metal, with songs about insects, biology and decay.
activity: Released 'Wasps In The Mouths of Shaky Snakes - Demos' on Aug 28, 2025, plus a live sessions release.

name: The Pleebs
description: Pop-punk band in Flemington's DIY scene. They have played Flemington DIY and venues as far as Brooklyn.
activity: Played Lucky 13 Saloon in Brooklyn on Mar 21, 2026, and released that set as 'Live from Lucky 13' on Apr 20, 2026. Also on a 2025 Flemington DIY bill (Songkick).

name: A Killer Ostrich
description: Four-piece playing grind and sludge that they jokingly call 'birdcore', from the heart of NJ.
activity: Released the album 'Old Hat' Apr 1, 2026 (members Cleo Becc, Dom Capasso, Robert Gardner, Aidan Elwood).

name: Pizza Steve
description: Instrumental noise-rock and sludge trio with a sense of humor. Guitarist Robert Gardner also plays bass in A Killer Ostrich.

name: Anachoret
description: Heavy psych band 'born from the forests of New Jersey', drawing on trance-like krautrock and doom.
activity: Released the compilation 'Repatriation of the Nomad' Jan 1, 2026, including a brand-new track that marks the band's new direction.

name: Coward's Justice
description: Band that bills itself as 'Dirty Jersey metalcore', playing heavy hardcore-leaning metal.

name: Sonic Foundry
description: Group project joining the Dorety Brothers (of Dimension Step) with guitarist Karl Fury, blending keyboards, guitar and percussive synthesis into progressive space music.

name: 10PENNY
description: Punk and grunge-leaning rock act from Glen Gardner in northern Hunterdon, tied to the local underground 'Punks in the Pool' DIY shows.
activity: Released the album 'Vendetta' on Jun 1, 2025. An earlier 10penny page has a 'Live on Main' release.
